en_boxty_cook.text: {greeting} Boxty on the griddle, boxty in the pan, if you can't make boxty, you'll never get a man. My granny's rhyme. She was a wonderful cook and a terrible matchmaker.
Grate your raw potatoes, squeeze the water out, mix with mashed potato, a bit of flour, buttermilk, and onto the griddle. Some boil it in a loaf and slice it. Both are right. Fight about it later.

then.text: Here, one hot off the griddle. Mind your fingers.

else.text: You've had your boxty for today. I'm not made of potatoes. Well. Partly.

en_bacon_man.text: {greeting} You'll be wanting the Fermanagh black bacon. Dry-cured, slow, with a dark, almost black rind from the cure. A wee bit of a rare breed revival, round here.
Fry it slow. If you rush it, the pig will know, and the pig will be disappointed in you. From beyond.
